title: Independence of scaled row entries
statement: Let $k,d$ be natural numbers, $x\in\mathbb{R}^d$, and let $i$ be one of the $k$ row indices. Under the product measure in which every array entry is an independent Rademacher random variable, the random variables $\omega\mapsto (x_j/\sqrt{k})\omega_{ij}$, indexed by the $d$ columns, are mutually independent.
hypotheses_covered: $i$ is a row index among the $k$ rows
the underlying measure is the product Rademacher measure on all array entries
replaced:
Fix natural numbers $k, d$, a vector $x \in \bbr^d$, and a row index $i \in
\{1,\dots,k\}$. Under the joint Rademacher product measure on
$\mathrm{Rad\Omega}(k,d)$, the family of real random variables
\[
\omega \;\longmapsto\; \frac{x_j}{\sqrt{k}}\,\omega_{ij}, \qquad j \in \{1,\dots,d\},
\]
indexed by the columns of row $i$, is mutually independent.
